BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to perfecting certain time periods under chapter50.32 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 50.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 50.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In filing an appeal, petition for hearing, petition for review, oradvisement order under this chapter, the time period shall be computedby excluding the day of delivery or mailing of the determination,redetermination, denial, order and notice of assessment, or decisionand including the last day. If the last day is a Saturday or Sunday ora holiday under RCW 1.16.050, the appeal, petition for hearing,petition for review, or advisement order must be perfected by the nextbusiness day.
